correctness.rationale: The exact infection-free vaccination-age distribution is obtained by characteristics, including its support y<=x and its normalization to p(x). Linearizing the original host and mosquito equations and integrating infected vaccination age cancels the transfer flux, leaving a positive scalar characteristic kernel. The modulus bound excludes all modes with nonnegative real growth when K<1; monotonicity of the real characteristic function yields a growing eigenmode when K>1. Stationary demographic renewal is checked exactly. The explicit piecewise-positive exposure rate leads to elementary closed forms for K(0), K(1), and the K(infinity) limit, whose sharp inequalities follow from exact Fraction-based rational intervals for exp(-1) (standalone verify.py, output VERIFY_OK). The infinite-dimensional conclusion comes from the displayed analytical proof, not finite computations. The result claims two distinct threshold crossings, not exactly two nor nonlinear endemic stability.

originality.rationale: The complete 2026 motivating preprint was inspected: it replaces variable vaccination-age efficacy with a constant averaged coefficient before analyzing an endemic fixed point, whereas the present claim derives the original unaveraged full-system infection threshold and a two-sided vaccination-rate invasion counterexample. Literature on waning immunity, vaccine-age reproductive numbers, and optimal vaccination schedules is acknowledged as antecedent. The particular full vector-host chronological-age example with strictly positive age exposure and exact re-entrant invasion intervals was not found in the accessible material. This is not a claim that vaccination timing effects are generally new. Restricted full texts and unindexed literature are residual risks, and no query is treated as a novelty certificate.

value.rationale: The result is not a generic positivity or normalization check. It constructs an exact counterexample to monotone epidemic-invasion control by speeding a one-dose vaccination hazard when efficacy wanes and risk is concentrated after the dose has aged. The problem is motivated by the original 2026 dual-age vaccine-age PDE, whose reported averaged-efficacy reduction deletes this timing mechanism. It gives explicit sharp above/below-one thresholds for biologically meaningful strictly positive age exposure and indicates when vaccine boosters, timing and age-specific force of infection cannot be ignored. The theorem has a complete self-contained analytical proof and rigorous rational numeric enclosures, without requiring claims of global nonlinear elimination.
